name: Heal
why: The healer's centre. Frame (four bonds) because healing holds a word together; draw from the workbook (EN 2.38).

name: Wither
why: Life's harm, past armour. Kept as is (EN 3.1).

name: Renew
why: Vigour is part of healing a body that has to keep fighting (EN 2.15).

name: Exhaust
why: Kept (EN 3.1). Its skill now draws the stamina it drains into you.

name: Strengthen
why: Kept (EN 2.1). Nature (its child) now owns buffs; Life's Strengthen stays the body growing, and its skill ties that to healing (heals refill poise).

name: Weaken
why: Kept (EN 3.0): the healer's way to blunt a heavy hitter.

name: Cure
meaning: end an affliction of the body: a sickness, a poison, a burn or a bleed
why: Narrowed from 'end a sickness or a poison' to afflictions of the body (the balance.json 'afflictions' list), so it does not overlap Holy's Absolve, which lifts binds (holds, slows, fear). Role and draw kept (EN 3.25).

name: Regrow
meaning: restore what was lost, limbs included
why: Regrowth is the role's name. Kept (EN 2.42).

name: Arrest
why: Kept (EN 3.55): the healer denies healing too.

name: Tithe
meaning: take life from a living body into yours
why: The role needs healing that is paid for by fighting (life-drain); no Life rune took life across from one body to another. Link: it takes in and passes on, from them to you. Strongly inward draw, so EN = 2.5 + 0.8 x 1.0 = 3.3. Distinct from Blood's Drink, which takes blood and never heals.

name: Bestow
meaning: give life outward into a body: your summons, or a small body of your own
why: With no party, a healer's outward gift goes to summons (Nature's beasts, its own Heartseed). Branch: it spreads to several bodies. Giving draw, EN = 2.5 - 0.6 x 0.7 = 2.08. As a means it makes what it touches last longer and reach further, the nearest honest ops to 'given wider'.
